authority: bounded local lifecycle candidate rollout evidence only; no production provider, router, promotion, service or remote credential authority
intake: exact issued EvaluationModelSource candidate, baseline and independent local verifier; source/model/runtime/training identity, MBOM, current lifecycle prefix, immutable heldout EvaluationSuite, deterministic assignment salt, seed and gate/cost policies pinned before inference

execution.phases: shadow completes before canary; both execute actual paired candidate/baseline generation and independent local verifier inference; shadow selects baseline, canary deterministically selects by SHA256 basis-point bucket
execution.requests: assignment decisions pinned before execution; contiguous drained per-case actual outputs, parsed verifier decisions/confidence, gold classifications, token counts and monotonic elapsed time persisted
execution.cost: integer local cost units derived from actual input/output tokens and immutable declared role tariffs; an accounting proxy, not billed price, energy or hosted provider cost
execution.rights: source training authority checked before inference and transactionally fenced before evidence publication/staging/cutover; rollback requires current restore baseline and verifier authority and can withdraw a revoked candidate
execution.contamination: existing observed training-document fingerprints checked against heldout prompt/full labeled sample; no semantic or factual correctness claim
execution.canary_coverage: both persisted candidate and baseline selection branches required for staging; paired generation runs for every request regardless selected local branch
execution.paired_input: same exact prompt, max output budget and generation seed for candidate/baseline; model identities differ; independent verifier gets the actual answer without expected gold label

gates: Completed measurement acceptance thresholds applied independently to each shadow/canary phase: actual candidate/baseline quality and verifier empirical metrics, exact output parity, per-phase token/cost accounting proxy and regression, per-inference completed elapsed-time gate, declared rights references and current authority; these thresholds are not cumulative runtime admission limits or cancellation timeouts; no caller scalar reports/approval flags

persistence.owner: existing versioned SQLite lifecycle snapshot row and repository transaction; no second durable authority
persistence.format: legacy snapshot v1 remains unchanged without rollouts; additive snapshot v2 includes rollout evidence and validates original lifecycle graph plus complete rollout plan/assignment/case/metric/stage/action graph
persistence.transactions: existing BEGIN IMMEDIATE + snapshot CAS; per-phase worker owner/monotonic epoch/expiry fences, precommit expiry recheck, durable case prefix reuse, atomic measured stage/cutover/rollback and lifecycle history
persistence.recovery: completed cases reused without inference; uncommitted work may retry; corruption, changed binding, stale model history or source revocation fail closed; ordinary caller-created receipt clones cannot execute
persistence.compatibility: read v1/v2; retain v1 until first admitted rollout; backup/restore uses existing validated repository machinery
